Matching movies instantly fails
Hello Everyone!

I'm a bit of a Plex newbie, but i'm really happy with my progress so far, matching, posters, metadata etc. has all been working great, but after recently re-sorting all my files on a new hard drive, I've run into an issue:

1. When trying to match any movie, I immediately get the "no matches were found using this agent" error
2. The console doesn't show any errors: "Completed: \[192.168.XX.XX:54547\] 200 GET /library/metadata/24/matches?manual=1&title=examplemovie&agent=tv.plex.agents.movie&year=2025&language=en-US (8 live) #12b4 TLS GZIP 6ms 614 bytes (pipelined: 3)"

I'm on MacOS, running on a Macbook Pro with a Windscribe VPN, and everything was working fine until I re-sorted all the files!

What I've tried:

* Tested all other agents (they all have the same issue)
* Deleted all app data & cache, re-installed PMS
* Changed DNS server
* Performed the "plex dance" (emptied folder, re-analyzed, re-populated folder)
* Added all my local IPs to the list of addresses and networks allowed without auth (192.168.0/24)

Thanks in advance for any help!
